risks.risk: Prior contents of the IBC (food-grade vs chemical/industrial residue) affecting safety and resale use
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any printed labels, UN markings, or residue stains on the tank body and cap interior
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/possibly chemical-grade, lower-value use case

risks.risk: Valve/spigot may be cracked or leaking
risks.proof: Short video clip of water flowing through the valve when opened

risks.risk: Cage and pallet rust or structural weakness
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos of the full cage frame and pallet underside

risks.risk: Plastic tank cracks, UV embrittlement, or discoloration not visible from the single front angle
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and top of the tank in daylight
Close-up photo of the capacity/volume plate usually on the cage
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common IBC size (e.g. 1000L minimum assumption)

risks.risk: Unclear how many units are actually for sale vs just displayed in the lot
risks.proof: A single photo showing all units tagged/marked as for-sale with a count
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only

proof_requests: Close-up of any UN/food-grade markings or labels on the tank
Video of the valve being opened to show water flow and leak check
Photos of the full cage and pallet from multiple angles, including underside
Photo of the capacity plate on the cage
Wide shot showing exact number of units being sold with any tags
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an IBC tank, so a worst-case price is possible, but seller's vague and unrelated claims (sand, cholesterol resistance) add no verifiable value and several condition risks remain unconfirmed.
